items.problem: Bootstrap inventory and its validator contract were incomplete for legacy linked project items.
items.root_cause: Filesystem recursion ignored evaluated csproj Link items, and the empty deferred sentinel differed between producer and consumer.
items.change: Parse legacy project item groups, expand common MSBuild properties including GetDirectoryNameOfFileAbove, copy linked items to Link destinations, seed them into mapping, and accept the canonical '(none)' deferred row.
items.expected_effect: Shared shell/scenario files become mandatory mapped work instead of manual, untracked reconstruction.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-running bootstrap on LanguageFont reports 20 mapped files including App.xaml, MainPage.xaml, both scenario XAML files, and Styles\Styles.xaml; zero-defer validation emits PASS rather than WARN.

items.problem: A directly hosted Page could rely on OnNavigatedTo and silently render an empty shell.
items.root_cause: The shell table endorsed direct Page hosting without its navigation-lifecycle constraint, and validation only checked process survival.
items.change: Correct the shell guidance and add a static validation failure when a Window directly hosts a Page that overrides OnNavigatedTo.
items.expected_effect: Agents must use Frame.Navigate or move required initialization to Loaded before validation can pass.
items.falsifiable_check: The trial's direct <sdk:MainPage /> plus OnNavigatedTo combination reports FAIL; after Frame navigation or Loaded initialization, both scenario items and their controls are reachable.

items.problem: Launch diagnosis rejected a valid default dotnet build layout.
items.root_cause: Target discovery searched only platform-qualified Debug directories.
items.change: Add bin\Debug to layout candidates while retaining platform-qualified precedence.
items.expected_effect: The prescribed launch diagnosis works immediately after default dotnet build.
items.falsifiable_check: With an executable and AppxManifest under bin\Debug\<tfm>\win-x64, -Target resolves that layout instead of returning 'No build output found'.
